paite: Mangbat ni in TOUPA'N hon dawng hen! Jakob' Pathian min in hon liahkhuh hen!
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La / Vualzohna Ngetna

paite: Mun siangthou a kipan in panpihna hon sawlsak henla, Zion a kipan in hon hihhat hen!
Na thillat teng theigige henla, na halmang thillat kipahpih hen! Selah
Na lungtang deihlam hon pia henla, na lunggel tengteng hon lohchingsak hen.
Na hotdamna ah nuam in la ka sa ding ua, ka Pathian min un ka puanzakte uh ka zak lai ding uh! TOUPA'N na ngetnate hon lohchingsak hen!
TOUPA'N athaunilh ahondam chih tu in ka theita; akhut taklam hotdamna tha in avan siangthou a kipan in amah ahon dawng ding hi.
Khenkhatte'n kangtalaite amuang ua, khenkhat in sakolte amuang uh, E'n zaw TOUPA i Pathian min i lou zaw ding hi
Amau zaw akun un, apukta ua; ei zaw i thou ua, i ding zawta hi.
TOUPA, hondam in! I sap chiang in kumpipa'n hon dawng hen.
